description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain class implementations used for testing activation garbage collection and activation collection behaviors, including idle, busy, and stateless worker grains with specific age limits.

classes.name: IdleActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: A simple idle activation test grain implementing IIdleActivationGcTestGrain1.

classes.name: IdleActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: A simple idle activation test grain implementing IIdleActivationGcTestGrain2.

classes.name: BusyActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: A busy activation test grain with activation identification and delay capabilities, implementing IBusyActivationGcTestGrain1.

classes.name: BusyActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: A busy activation test grain implementing IBusyActivationGcTestGrain2.

classes.name: CollectionSpecificAgeLimitForTenSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with a specific age limit of ten seconds for activation collection, implementing ICollectionSpecificAgeLimitForTenSecondsActivationGcTestGrain.

classes.name: CollectionSpecificAgeLimitForZeroSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with zero seconds age limit for activation collection, implementing ICollectionSpecificAgeLimitForZeroSecondsActivationGcTestGrain.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivationCollectorTestGrain1
classes.description: A stateless worker grain with activation identification and delay, implementing IStatelessWorkerActivationCollectorTestGrain1.

methods.name: Nop
methods.description: A method that completes immediately, used as a no-operation placeholder.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: A method that delays execution for a specified TimeSpan.

methods.name: IdentifyActivation
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the activation.
